novel_features.name: Price and availability history
novel_features.description: Query local observations to see price, stock, rating, and availability movement over time.
novel_features.rationale: Repeated API responses become a local time series that the hosted MCP and REST API do not retain.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Choose this when an agent needs to explain what changed instead of fetching only the current value.

novel_features.name: Observation diff
novel_features.description: Show the field-level changes between the latest saved observations.
novel_features.rationale: A local snapshot diff answers change questions without spending another paid API credit.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Choose this after ingestion when an agent needs a precise price, stock, or ETA delta.

novel_features.name: Fastest available delivery
novel_features.description: Rank currently available delivery options while preserving closed or unparseable platforms.
novel_features.rationale: The CLI normalizes ETA values and combines availability semantics across live or local observations.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Choose this when an agent must recommend a viable fastest platform rather than list raw ETA rows.

novel_features.name: Credit-aware request planner
novel_features.description: Calculate fan-out credit cost and affordability before making paid platform requests.
novel_features.rationale: Free credit balance data plus per-platform pricing rules can prevent avoidable 402 failures.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Choose this before an agent launches a multi-platform search or ETA fan-out.

novel_features.name: Manual mirror ingestion
novel_features.description: Persist real QuickCommerce command responses and metadata into the local SQLite mirror.
novel_features.rationale: A durable local mirror makes ephemeral REST and hosted MCP results searchable and comparable later.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Choose this when an agent wants future history, offline search, or a reproducible observation record.

novel_features.name: Stale-observation report
novel_features.description: Find saved product and ETA observations that are older than a chosen trust window.
novel_features.rationale: Manual refresh semantics and fetched timestamps let the CLI expose stale data before it is used.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Choose this before making decisions from local data whose location-sensitive freshness matters.

novel_features.name: Local platform/location coverage
novel_features.description: Report observed, missing, and stale platform coverage for a location.
novel_features.rationale: Joining capability metadata with local observations reveals gaps that supported-platforms alone cannot show.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Choose this when an agent needs to know whether a location has usable evidence across platforms.

novel_features.name: Price-per-unit value view
novel_features.description: Compare price per unit from explicit pack quantities without guessing missing units.
novel_features.rationale: Local product observations retain pack-size text that can be normalized deterministically for value comparisons.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Choose this when the cheapest sticker price may not be the cheapest comparable quantity.

narrative.headline: Compare live Indian product prices, stock, and delivery ETAs from the terminal, then keep the history locally.
narrative.value_prop: QuickCommerce CLI covers the provider's REST and hosted-MCP surface while adding a local mirror for repeatable analysis. Use history, fastest delivery, credit planning, stale-data checks, and unit-price views to turn location-sensitive responses into decisions.
narrative.auth_narrative: Set QUICKCOMMERCE_API_KEY to the API key from the QuickCommerce dashboard. The CLI sends it as X-API-Key and keeps paid calls explicit; platform discovery is available without a key.

quickstart.comment: Confirm the CLI configuration path without making a paid request.
See which platforms support search, item lookup, and ETA.
Preview a location-aware product search request.
Preview a cross-platform comparison before spending credits.

troubleshoots.fix: Export QUICKCOMMERCE_API_KEY and rerun quickcommerce-pp-cli doctor --json.
Run quickcommerce-pp-cli account --json, then reduce the platform list or add credits.
Run quickcommerce-pp-cli platforms --json and use a supported platform with decimal latitude/longitude.

troubleshoots.symptom: DMart, JioMart, or Minutes returns location errors
troubleshoots.fix: Add --pincode with the six-digit delivery pincode.
Run quickcommerce-pp-cli mirror stale --max-age 24h --json before relying on the mirror.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI for location-aware product search, price and stock comparisons, delivery ETA decisions, and repeatable local analysis across Indian commerce platforms. It is especially useful when an agent needs bounded JSON, credit-aware fan-out, and historical context instead of one ephemeral API response.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI to place orders, manage carts, or perform checkout; the API exposes read-only product and delivery data.
Do not use the local mirror as proof of current availability without checking its age; refresh paid observations deliberately.
Do not use this CLI for platforms or locations outside the documented QuickCommerce API coverage.
